page_sets.ui.steps_hint.source: A JSON array of steps. Each step is {"type":"navigate","url":...}, {"type":"click","selector":...} (or "text" to click by visible text) or {"type":"fill","selector":...,"value":...}. Add "checkpoint": true to capture and compare a screenshot at that step, "before_seconds": 1 to pause before a step, "delay_seconds": 3 to pause after a step, "outline_seconds" / "glide_seconds" to size a click's outline and cursor glide in the recording, and "value_env": "ADMIN_PASSWORD" to read a value from the project's own .env file instead of storing it here.
page_sets.ui.steps_hint.translation: Polje JSON s koraki. Vsak korak je {"type":"navigate","url":...}, {"type":"click","selector":...} (ali "text" za klik po vidnem besedilu) ali {"type":"fill","selector":...,"value":...}. Dodajte "checkpoint": true, da na tem koraku zajamete in primerjate posnetek zaslona; "before_seconds": 1 za premor pred korakom; "delay_seconds": 3 za premor po koraku; "outline_seconds" / "glide_seconds" za trajanje orisa in drsenja kazalca pri kliku v posnetku; z "value_env": "ADMIN_PASSWORD" preberete vrednost iz projektove datoteke .env, namesto da bi jo shranili tukaj.
